_note: v3.0 plan 19 (NOT YET RUN; the live gate is owed). Opening hook order on a fresh group chat: the scripted new_chat_only opener, then the start beat's scripted entering line, then the llm new_chat_only ask_player hook of Arin (after_member DM Narrator). No model is needed for the order and the counters: the hook's fire count is recorded before its /trigger, and on a no-model lane the /trigger may post an empty or failed reply. Also checks the one-shot direction is gone from the guidance block once the hook has finished. The hook's wording (does Arin address the player, does it avoid narrating the player) needs the real-LLM journey listed in docs/plans/v3.0/19-talk-pacing.md.

requires.why: scripted opener, scripted entering line and one /trigger; the order is code, not model output

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s), so the new_chat_only opener could never post`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const until = Date.now() + 120000; while (Date.now() < until && !(rt.extras.firedNpcReplies?.['road:onEnter:Arin:1'] === 1 && !document.body.dataset.generating)) await sleep(250); await sleep(1500); const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; const opener = chat.findIndex((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').startsWith('SO-V3019-OPENER')); const enter = chat.findIndex((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').startsWith('SO-V3019-ENTER')); const arin = chat.findIndex((m) => m?.name === 'Arin' && !m.is_user && !m.is_system); const fired = rt.extras.firedNpcReplies ?? {}; const guidance = String(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''); const state = { opener, enter, arin, fired, rows: chat.length, guidanceHasOneShot: guidance.includes('this reply:') }; if (opener !== 0) throw new Error('the opener is not the first line: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (enter !== 1) throw new Error('the entering line did not follow the opener: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (fired['road:onEnter:DM Narrator:0'] !== 1 || fired['road:onEnter:DM Narrator:2'] !== 1 || fired['road:onEnter:Arin:1'] !== 1) throw new Error('the opener, entering line and hook did not each fire once: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (arin >= 0 && arin < enter) throw new Error('the hook landed before the entering line: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (state.guidanceHasOneShot) throw new Error('the one-shot direction outlived the hook: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); return state;
